_meta.purpose: Complete dataset for bootstrapping the Moxie development database. Contains all entities needed to render every prototype screen with real data. Run the companion SQL migration first, then insert this data.
_meta.source: Extracted from all design prototypes, technical handoff v1, tech brief, brand guide, and founder records as of April 2026.
notes_for_agents: UUIDs below are deterministic placeholders — generate real UUIDs in production but keep these stable in dev/staging so hardcoded references in tests work.
All dates use ISO 8601. Expiry dates are set to Dec 31, 2025 in prototypes — update to current year + 1 when seeding a live environment.
Fields marked [PLACEHOLDER] use demo values from the HTML prototypes. Ben will replace these with real values before any external demo.
Photo URLs reference Supabase Storage paths — upload actual images to these paths after bucket creation.
The two vessels below (Discovery One + Polaris) are the ONLY vessels that should exist in the database at launch. Do not generate fake data.
